description: Manually authored held-out anonymous queries. Relevance labels are synthetic editorial judgments, not judgments about families. Queries are never used to fit vectors or select the fixed threshold.

queries.text: Buying pencils and notebooks is difficult.
Textbooks and stationery cost more than we can manage.
Bus fares make the journey difficult.
We need affordable transport for a long journey.
Hunger distracts from lessons and breakfast would help.
Lunch and nutrition support would make learning easier.
Internet data is expensive and we cannot borrow a tablet.
A shared computer would help with digital homework.
We need printed exercises without electricity.
Paper worksheets would let us study without a connection.
Fractions and arithmetic are confusing and patient practice would help.
We would like help with maths and writing.
Bilingual explanations would make unfamiliar vocabulary easier.
Translation would help us understand lessons in a new language.
Large print and audio would make reading easier.
Captions would help with hearing access to lessons.
Noise and crowding make concentration hard.
We need a calm space away from distractions.
Caregiving means we need flexible timing for lessons.
Household responsibilities leave little time for study sessions.
Feeling overwhelmed and worry get in the way of studying.
Stress makes it difficult to concentrate and a listening conversation would help.
Enrollment forms and paperwork are confusing.
We want a guide to explain support options and referral information.
Internet data costs and bus fares both make learning difficult.
We need notebooks and patient maths practice.

challenge_queries.text: We cannot afford the ride to class.
An empty stomach makes it hard to focus.
The web is too costly and we lack a laptop.
We need someone to explain sums slowly.
Taking care of relatives interrupts our routine.
The house is loud and there is nowhere to focus.
